title: Transliteration guidelines
description: Guidelines on Transliteration according to the guidelines set by the Office of the Royal Society

blocks.heading: Transliteration guidelines
blocks.lead: Guidelines set by the Office of the Royal Society

sections.html:
1. Transliteration should render the letters of the source language closely enough to show the origin of the word, and should be written in a form that is easy to read in Thai.

2. Separate transliteration guidelines have been set for each language.

3. Transliterated words that have long been in use, are regarded as Thai and already appear in the Royal Institute Dictionary, continue to be used as before, e.g. ช็อกโกเลต, ช็อกโกแลต (chocolate), เชิ้ต (shirt), ก๊าซ, แก๊ส (gas)

4. Proper nouns that have long been in use may continue to be used as before, for example:

Victoria = วิกตอเรีย
Louis = หลุยส์
Cologne = โคโลญ

5. For technical terms used only by specialist groups, rather than general vocabulary, additional guidelines may be set as necessary.
